opentsc-opentsc-root.description: OpenTSC v2.1: Soul/Shell architecture for interpersonal intelligence. Local, offline-first, with event graphs, judgment engine (K7), self-creation (K8), three-layer attributes, calibrated predictions, 11 VSM professions, and a pluggable zvec memory index (semantic search, identity resolution, jieba segmentation, emotion scoring incl. batched+cached LLM) that runs with zero extra deps. Transforms implicit social judgment into explicit, queryable, auditable, evolving intelligence.
